title: Tech and Stuff
description: This Minecraft MODPACK plans to add vanilla plus mods by also adding dimensions and tech and magic mods to make money more fun and feel like there is unlimited things to do that is unique!
body: A fun and massive Minecraft 1.20.1 modpack that revolves around the theme of Create, alongside its addons, where the player experiences technology, magic, and other new dimensions all in one vanilla-modded adventure. Construct elaborate devices, travel to new dimensions, and find countless methods to advance your gameplay experience.
